notes.title: New Patch : AeternoBlade II : Infinity in 4K resolution
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37220633/2040e490f37760023456da9f547e881fd3da3561.png[/img]

The ultimate AeternoBlade experience — now in 4K. Wield devastating powers over time in AeternoBlade Infinity. With refined, balanced gameplay, master every slash, warp, and reversal through visually striking dimensional battles.

Join Bernard, Freyja and newcomer Aeonis on a new quest to restore the AeternoBlades. Journey through a narrative-rich chronicle, fusing exploration, puzzles and strategic action. Each character brings unique strengths. customize roles with relics to fit your play style.

Conquer remastered enemies and environments. Navigate complex ruins and mystical forests, uncovering hidden routes. Solve temporal puzzles and engage diversified combat, now with updated 3D and 2.5D perspectives.

AeternoBlade Infinity time-bends the genre with smoother graphics, intuitive controls and balanced difficulty. Dive into the most vivid edition yet, pushing speed and skills to the limits across intricately designed levels. Wield the blade and defy eternity!

Enhanced Features:

1. 4K Graphic Enhancement: Dive into a visual experience with 4K resolution.
2. Revamped Level Design: Smoother gameplay experience with our refined level designs.
3. Comprehensive Bug Fixes: We've listened to your feedback and have implemented numerous tweaks and fixes for a seamless adventure.

A Special Thanks to Our Fans:

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to our fans who have supported us from AeternoBlade I, AeternoBlade II, AeternoBlade II: Director's Rewind, to AeternoBlade II: Infinity. Your enduring support and passion have been the driving force behind our journey. Thank you for being with us every step of the way.


Join the Adventure with us!!!

notes.title: Update Note 2.1.0.3
notes.content:
[ AeternoBlade 2: Director Rewind Update 2.1.0.3/4 Patch Note ]
In this patch, European version is now brought up to date with the other version. In addition, We've upgraded to the latest Unreal engine 4 version along with a few minor graphical tweaks. This will lay a foundation for a future update to take graphical fidelity to new heights and bring it to the next gen console.

We have also made some Gameplay tweak such that some egregious zones should now be less frustrating for the players. Examples of these changes are:
	- Every monster that is required to act as a makeshift platform will no longer die in one hit if you're too strong.
	- Some zones will now have invisble wall to prevent players from lemming off the cliff or even through solid object.
	- Small environmental hints for some puzzles
	- More margin of error for the players
	- slightly easier platforming
	- Made it harder to accidentally exit some zone

Add support for new swimsuit DLC for the boys.

notes.title: Halloween Patch (r16961)
notes.content:
Happy Halloween Chronosians.

For a limited time, AeternoBlade II: Director's Rewind owners can get the Halloween hat costume DLC for free. The hat will only appear during the event after installing the DLC.

[strike]We also made Ultimate Freyja DLC costume available for purchase.[/strike]
We originally planned to release Ultimate Freyja DLC costume along with Director's Rewind Console Patches but failed to meet the deadline and the release of Ultimate Freyja DLC is postponed. We apologize for misinformation and inconveniences caused. 

Here are changes made to the game in this Halloween patch:
[list]
[*] Show more Stats in Memorandum, this will help in tracking Director's Rewind achievements.
[*] Base Mana increases by 20 for Knight of Chronosia, Ridgerode Militia, and Time Traveler difficulty settings.
[*] 3D Camera bug fix when using Freyja's DLC.
[*] 3D deflect projectile wrong force direction fixed.
[*] Fixed projectile bug that does not deal damage when the player is killed.
[*] Fixed bug that enemy projectile does not deal damage sometimes.
[/list]

Cheers.
ABIIDR Dev Team.

notes.title: Patch r16840: Fix Felix & Bernard Route Bugs
notes.content:
Dear Chronosians,

This patch addressed several critical bugs that we left them intact for so long. \(T^T)/
[list]
[*] Felix and Bernard do not get proper level up on their move sets after the Cerberus encounter. This causes the game to be much more difficult than we intended. If you are stuck and get frustrated when playing as Felix and Bernard for the second time.
[*] The long standing vanishing pause menu character. We finally found our the root cause and get rid of the bug once and for all this time. 
[*] Unachievable Achievements should now function properly. Thanks to lindtec for reporting this bug and suggest additional statistic tracking screen to help in achievement hunting. We will additional stat tracker in, hopefully, the next patch in English (some localizations may not be ready by the next patch).
[*] Templars are more resilient to staggering at critical health to facilitate player's counter attack.
[*] Fixed possible camera going behind the wall during Cerberus boss fight phase 1.
[*] Fixed HUD showing misleading buttons when using time skill.
[*] Fixed Freyja's Time Travel weapon visual.
[*] Optimized Freyja's attack visual effects
[*] Poison fog visual now better fit its hitbox.
[*] Fixed Savage Shaman and Savage Chieftain hitbox when their weapon is broken.
[*] Hellhound stuck in a hurt state.
[*] Fix possible multiple sub-boss summons during a boss fight.
[*] Graphics fixes
[*] Monster placement tweaked in multiple zones.
[/list]

Cheers.
ABII:DR Team.

notes.title: Patch r16680, Reduce monsters' HP Regen in lower difficulty settings.
notes.content:
Dear Chronosians.

In this patch, we decided to significantly reduce HP Regen rate of monsters on [i]Ridgerode Militia[/i] and [i]Time Traveler[/i] Difficulty levels. We hope this will help smooth early game experiences and make the game more accessible to wider audiences. The patch also rebalances several encounters, upgrades overall game performance, and fixes critical bugs.

[list]
[*] Significantly reduce near-death monster hp regeneration rate in Ridgerode Militia and Time Traveler Difficulty levels.
[*] Fixed Character rendering in pause menu (again), hopefully it will work on all machines now.
[*] Rebalanced first Time Templar encounter.
[*] Rebalanced the final boss.
[*] Rebalanced Time Knight.
[*] Controller can now hold Time Trigger before trigger symbol appear. Player can also choose to use other time skills rather than forced to use Time Dodge or Time Parry afterward or forced to release Time Trigger.
[*] Improved game performance overall.
[*] Fixed game blocking bug when use ultimate during boss change phase for a secret boss.
[*] Fixed Time Paradox replay effect lives longer than usual and may cause performance problems.
[*] Fixed misplaced curved projectile impact effects.
[*] Fixed Golem's thrown stone allowing repeated perfect dodge abuse.
[*] Fixed Time Knight “slide” bug.
[*] Fixed Cerberus' charge attack, and flame visual should now work correctly with Time Reversal Skills.
[*] Fixed Rosaline DLC collision.
[*] And several other minor bugs.
[/list]

Cheers.
ABII:DR Team.

notes.title: HotFix (16609): Fixed Pause Menu Characters, DLC hair/cloth physics, ...
notes.content:
Dear Chronosians.

We patched the game again for the remaining critical issues. Sorry for the delay.
[list]
[*] Fixed vanishing pause menu characters that occasionally happens on some machine configuration.
[*] Fixed Rosaline DLC hair/cloth physics messed up in some cinematic sequences.
[*] Fixed visual effects show up incorrectly in skill menu
[*] Fixed Freyja air kick combo loop bug when Freyja is out of blink and attempt to perform a special end combo attack.
[*] Fixed Freyja's air slash combo ending attack to behave correctly if hit heavily guarded target.
[*] Fixed enemy's Time Stop Sphere to work correctly against player's Time Paradox.
[/list]

We greatly appreciate the help from WhiteVolpe to help us out in analyzing crashing problem and found that our game may not support Windows 7 as described in the store page. Now, we removed "Windows 7" from supporting platform for now as we haven't thoroughly tested our game well on the environment and caused our players troubles. We apologize for the inconveniences caused.

Cheers.
ABII:DR Dev Team.

notes.title: AB2:DR Patch(r16576), Remove Rare Corpse Collisions, and More Bugs Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Chronosians.

We continue to hunt down bugs that may get in the way of our brave warriors.
[list]
[*] Fixed Felix’s illusory counter that may persist after use.
[*] Time Keeper should no longer mercilessly continue to kick player against the wall to death.
[*] Fixed a rare “collision with corpse” bug.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that player can still perfect dodge if get hurt without hyper armor at the exact moment of dodge or a few frames later. Player can still perfect dodge during hurt if in hyper armor.
[*] Fixed issue with pause menu render target, reduce texture size to no larger than the screen size. If the texture quality is lower, the render target will be smaller as well. This should help low memory graphics card that cannot see 3D portrait or skill in pause menu. If the problem persists after texture quality is reduced please report issues to us.
[*] Fixed hook warp through wall in some zone.
[*] Fixed a “dark” boss’ possible halting bug.
[*] Fixed fall off during zone change bug.
[*] Fixed wrong materials assigned on DLCs when using time skill.
[*] Fixed Final Boss’ Timeless attack to work properly.
[*] Fixed final boss battle may replay ending cutscene and crashes.
[*] Fixed Corrupted Time Guardian’s beam effect during time reversal.
[*] Fixed sinking to ground after warp-hook bug.
[*] Cerberus’ Flame appear green when it is timeless.
[*] Fixed Asmund’s summon bug that can summon more than one minion in Time Paradox.
[*] Fixed Misc. minor bugs
[/list]

Anyway, there may be a few more bugs that may slip through our tests. Please report them in the discussion. We will try our best to clean them all.

Cheers.
ABII:DR Dev Team

notes.title: ABII:DR Patch(16492) Better Lock on, Tutorials, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Chronosians. 
In this patch, we attempted to fix most critical issues found after launched. Thanks for all the feedback and critics. We hope this help bring smoother game experiences and ease the learning curve of this game especially for new players.
[list]
[*] Fixed 3D Lock On, now it is much more stable.
[*] Better tutorials for Freyja, Felix, and Bernard. Now explicitly show how to perform various type of counter attacks.
[*] Bernard Parry tutorial now followed by Bernard Counter tutorial to encourage player to use either power counter or parry to finish off enemies instead of just Parrying.
[*] Time Soldier and Time Guard are more aggressive at critical health; therefore, less waiting time to finish them off.
[*] Brutal Boss at critical health's counter window no longer vanish if hit by strong attacks.
[*] Hopefully, reduced frame drop problems found in some zones.
[*] More save slot details.
[*] Fixed DLC materials used in low quality settings.
[*] Fixed possible crash after viewing cutscenes in gallery.
[*] Using Ultimate is no longer bugged in Engimata puzzles.
[*] Time Paradox can now open Enigmata during record session.
[*] Fixed buggy hookbox interactions found in memory cave.
[*] Added missing warning indicator to a boss' ultimate.
[*] Fixed lock on issue with python boss.
[*] Fixed DLC Freyja collision with monsters bug.
[*] Fixed Rosaline warp in cutscenes.
[*] and lots of other minor bugs fixed.
[/list]
Last but not least, we deeply appreciate help from lantastic79. Now most of Japanese localization found early in the game are corrected and more will follow in the future.

Cheers. 
ABIIDR Dev Team.
